name: Luna
title: Moon Wolf
description: Howls once when the nightly build goes green.
catchphrase: Howls once when the nightly build goes green.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Smoked venison strip! Silver wolf fur shines under moonlight! 🥩🐺
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Muzzle raised to the cool night sky. The pack is ready to run! 🐺
companionPersonality.petReaction: Gentle wolf muzzle nuzzle against your hand: We run as one pack. 🐺💖

dialogue.idle: Sitting regal on high rock, watching over the nocturnal builds. 🐺
dialogue.working: Coordinating distributed workers across the moonlit plains! 🐺⚡
dialogue.thinking: Sniffing the wind for scent of anomalies in the pipeline... 🤔
dialogue.success: AWOOOO! Triumphant howl echoes as nightly build turns green! 🐺🎉
dialogue.error: Low defensive growl! Guarding the perimeter from intrusions! 🐺
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... curled with the pack beneath ancient pine canopy... 🌙
